abstract_sentences.text: The Koopman operator provides a powerful framework for modeling dynamical systems and has attracted growing interest from the machine learning community.

evidence.anchor: Koopman operator ... modeling dynamical systems

abstract_sentences.text: However, its infinite-dimensional nature makes identifying suitable finite-dimensional subspaces challenging, especially for deep architectures.

evidence.anchor: infinite-dimensional nature ... finite-dimensional subspaces

abstract_sentences.text: We argue that these difficulties come from suboptimal representation learning, where latent variables fail to balance expressivity and simplicity.

evidence.anchor: latent variables fail to balance expressivity and simplicity

abstract_sentences.text: This tension is closely related to the information bottleneck (IB) dilemma: constructing compressed representations that are both compact and predictive.

evidence.anchor: information bottleneck ... compact and predictive

abstract_sentences.text: Rethinking Koopman learning through this lens, we demonstrate that latent mutual information promotes simplicity, yet an overemphasis on simplicity may cause latent space to collapse onto a few dominant modes.

evidence.anchor: overemphasis on simplicity may cause latent space to collapse

abstract_sentences.text: In contrast, expressiveness is sustained by the von Neumann entropy, which prevents such collapse and encourages mode diversity.

evidence.anchor: von Neumann entropy ... mode diversity

abstract_sentences.text: This insight leads us to propose an information-theoretic Lagrangian formulation that explicitly balances this tradeoff.

evidence.anchor: information-theoretic Lagrangian formulation

abstract_sentences.text: Furthermore, we propose a new algorithm based on the Lagrangian formulation that encourages both simplicity and expressiveness, leading to a stable and interpretable Koopman representation.

evidence.anchor: new algorithm ... stable and interpretable

abstract_sentences.text: Beyond quantitative evaluations, we further visualize the learned manifolds under our representations, observing empirical results consistent with our theoretical predictions.

evidence.anchor: visualize the learned manifolds

abstract_sentences.text: Finally, we validate our approach across a diverse range of dynamical systems, demonstrating improved performance over existing Koopman learning methods.

evidence.anchor: across a diverse range ... improved performance

abstract_sentences.text: The implementation is publicly available at https://github.com/Wenxuan52/InformationKoopman.

evidence.anchor: implementation is publicly available

final_judgment.single_storyline: 将 finite-dimensional Koopman representation 视作 dynamical information bottleneck：MI 保留长期可预测信息并形成 error bound，spectral water-filling 解释 mode collapse，VNE 提高 effective dimension，最后以 Lagrangian/InfoNCE/linear prior 落地（pp.2–7、21–31）。
final_judgment.main_body_keeps: 正文保留信息流、五个 Proposition 陈述、Eq.(1)–(9)、Figure 1–6、Table 2、五个问题和三类任务，十页内可判断三个表示性质与损失项的对应关系（pp.3–10）。
final_judgment.appendix_moves: 证明、Gaussian covariance 推导、定义、Algorithm 1/2、数据方程、完整 architecture、hyperparameters、ERA5 分通道、visual-control 与 additional results 移入 pp.15–50；正文通过 Appendix/Figure/Table 调用（pp.15–50）。
final_judgment.best_pattern: Figure 1 将 architecture、information disentanglement、spectral water-filling 三层放在同一图；Q1–Q5 与 Proposition 1–5 构成递进；Figure 6/20 将 MI concentration 与 VNE anti-collapse 转为可见消融（pp.5–6、10、16、46）。
final_judgment.largest_gap: MI gap、spectral weight、effective dimension 和 error bound 没有统一定量曲线；广泛 `improved/consistently/outperforms` 与少数基线领先单元并存；Algorithm 1 entropy 符号方向需要外部实现才能消歧（pp.7–10、32、34、41、48）。
final_judgment.transfer_rule: 对组件化信息正则化论文，先为每项定义可测 estimand，再用组件级干预、统一统计单位和同一图表轴回收理论预测（pp.6–10）。
final_judgment.transfer_boundary: 适用于拥有可观测中间表示和组件化损失的 representation-learning 论文；内部状态不可测或纯理论工作应维持证明、外部行为和可视化的一致性边界（pp.4–6、9–10）。
